record.title: Validate offline private-cache acquisition assumptions
record.intent: Falsify the proposed cache decoder and read boundaries with positive and negative offline controls.
requirements: Use preserved artifacts and synthetic host fixtures only. Derive positive fixtures independently where possible from stock-produced private streams.
Require bounded lengths, mapped readable ranges, duplicate-snapshot consistency and rejection of malformed or changing state as applicable to the recovered contract.
Preserve failures separately. No physical access, installation, process attachment or raw I2C operations.
acceptance: Offline controls establish which acquisition assumptions are testable and which still need guest or physical evidence.
